svg.text: Docker architecture — what actually happens on docker run
asks the kernel for namespaces + cgroups
an ordinary process with its own view of the world
The three words people mix up
Dockerfile — the recipe. A text file of instructions. Costs nothing until you build it.
Image — the build artifact. Read-only, layered, portable. This is what moves between machines.
Container — a running instance of an image, plus a thin writable layer. One image, many containers.
